summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised: 1 backend pytest file (7 sub-tests covering pricing tiers, First50 server-confirmed total/savings, Razorpay test-mode order creation, invalid-book rejection) + 8 named browser checks covering homepage/collection 'Get all 5 books', confirmed Remove All, absence of redundant Add-more footer with working recommendation add, progressive pricing display, backend-confirmed Razorpay review + hosted checkout open, guest bag persistence/dedup, and responsive desktop+390px storefront. All passed; no bugs found.

checks.criterion: Progressive pricing and First50 presentation remain accurate (API: tiers 1-4)
checks.name: test_tscheck_pricing_and_razorpay_review.py::test_progressive_pricing_tiers
checks.evidence: POST /api/pricing/quote for 1/2/3/4 book_ids returned total_inr 249/399/549/699 respectively (4 parametrized cases, all 200).

checks.criterion: Progressive pricing and First50 presentation remain accurate (API: 5-book conditional)
checks.name: test_tscheck_pricing_and_razorpay_review.py::test_five_book_quote_is_conditional_until_verified
checks.evidence: POST /api/pricing/quote with 5 book_ids -> 200, total_inr=999, eligibility_status='needs_verification', eligible_first_time=null (conditional until checkout verification), matching seed facts.

checks.criterion: Razorpay review is backend-confirmed and mode-aware (API: order creation)
checks.name: test_tscheck_pricing_and_razorpay_review.py::test_razorpay_order_confirms_first50_total_and_test_mode
checks.evidence: POST /api/payments/razorpay/order with 5 fresh-email book_ids -> 200, payment_mode='test', amount_paise=49900, pricing.total_inr=499, total_savings_inr=746, coupon_code='FIRST50', razorpay_order_id starts with 'order_'.

checks.criterion: Razorpay review is backend-confirmed and mode-aware (API: invalid book rejected)
checks.name: test_tscheck_pricing_and_razorpay_review.py::test_razorpay_order_rejects_invalid_book_id
checks.evidence: POST /api/payments/razorpay/order with book_ids=['not-a-real-book-id'] -> 422 (rejected, not silently accepted).

checks.criterion: Homepage Get all 5 books completes any partial bag without duplicates
checks.name: homepage-get-all-5-completes-partial-bag
checks.evidence: Started with 1 book selected (The First Table via product page), clicked collection-primary-cta on homepage; smart-bag-drawer opened with exactly 5 smart-bag-item-* rows, milestone message 'Your complete collection is unlocked.', price summary showed ₹499, and localStorage knowledge_concierge_bag_v1 contained 5 unique ids.

checks.criterion: Collection-page Get all 5 books uses the same complete-collection behavior
checks.name: collection-page-get-all-5-from-empty-bag
checks.evidence: From an empty bag, clicked collection-page-add-all-btn on /restaurant-business-collection; bag opened with 5 unique smart-bag-item-* rows and 5 unique ids persisted to localStorage.

checks.criterion: Remove All requires confirmation and correctly supports cancel and confirm
checks.name: remove-all-requires-confirmation
checks.evidence: Clicking smart-bag-remove-all-btn showed smart-bag-clear-confirmation; 'Keep books' (cancel) preserved the 1 selected item and its localStorage entry; re-opening and clicking 'Remove all' (confirm) cleared visible items (smart-bag-empty-state shown, 0 item rows) and localStorage bag became empty.

checks.criterion: The redundant Add more books footer control is absent
checks.name: smart-bag-recommendations-no-redundant-footer
checks.evidence: Partial bag (1 book) showed smart-bag-recommendations with 4 direct smart-bag-recommend-add-* controls; smart-bag-add-more-btn had 0 matches throughout; clicking a recommendation add control increased selected items to 2 and updated the price summary to ₹399 (2-book tier) immediately.

checks.criterion: Progressive pricing and First50 presentation remain accurate (UI)
checks.name: progressive-pricing-tiers-display
checks.evidence: On /books, sequentially adding 1-5 books via book-card-add-btn-* updated library-progress-summary to show 249/399/549/699/499 at counts 1-5 respectively; opening the bag at 5 books showed 'Estimated total' ₹499.

checks.criterion: Razorpay review is backend-confirmed and mode-aware (UI)
checks.name: checkout-review-backend-confirmed-razorpay-test-mode
checks.evidence: Filled checkout form with a fresh @example.com email, POST /api/payments/razorpay/order returned 200 with pricing.total_inr=499 and total_savings_inr=746; razorpay-mode-badge showed 'RAZORPAY · TEST MODE'; razorpay-confirmed-total showed ₹499; clicking razorpay-open-btn opened the hosted Razorpay checkout.js iframe with no console/page errors captured.

checks.criterion: The guest bag persists safely across navigation and refresh
checks.name: guest-bag-persists-navigation-and-refresh
checks.evidence: Added 1 book, duplicate add kept count at 1; navigated /faq -> /books and count remained 1 in bag; full page reload on /books still showed 1 selected item and localStorage retained 'the-first-table'.

checks.criterion: Core storefront remains responsive and navigable
checks.name: core-storefront-responsive-desktop-and-mobile
checks.evidence: Run against public preview URL https://business-wisdom-5.preview.emergentagent.com. At 1280x900 and 390x844, home/library/product/collection/faq routes all had documentElement scrollWidth-clientWidth <=4px (no horizontal overflow); at 390px the bag opened with checkout button visible; zero failed network requests and no non-Razorpay console errors.
